outputs.explanation: Panel A is a western blot image, not a plot; no averaged data is shown so individual data points are not applicable.
Panel B consists of phase-contrast micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.

The bottom bar chart in panel C (percentage of cells) displays individual data points (circle, square, triangle markers) overlaid on the mean ± SEM bars for n=3 replicates; the top flow cytometry density plots are representative raw scatter data, not averaged.
The bottom bar chart in panel D shows individual data points overlaid on the mean ± SD bars (n=3); the top flow cytometry plots are representative raw data, not an average.
Panel E is a heatmap of Z-scored gene expression; heatmaps are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel F is a western blot image, not a plot of averaged data.
Both bar charts in panel G (pluripotency and lineage marker genes) display individual data points (circle, square, triangle markers) overlaid on the mean ± SEM bars for n=3 replicates.
Panel H shows immunofluorescence micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
